title: Q: Prove cross-company accounting reads stay isolated
public_pr_body:
Q found a missing explicit cross-company read case in #221/#230: token/provider tests stayed in Company A. Add a DB-free test through the real routes and connection adapters: connect fake Sage/QBO for A, switch to B, supply A's company/tenant IDs in status/check requests. B gets no connection name or balance, makes no provider/token-lease call, and cannot change either encrypted connection.

Reset the existing fixture's company/person before each case so tests cannot depend on execution order. No existing assertion changed or weakened and no application/SQL changes.

Based on final accounting O #237 (codex/o-accounting-combined), including R's fix. Diff ONLY tests/unit/accounting-token-isolation.test.ts.

Validation: 9 accounting route/isolation unit tests passed, typecheck and targeted ESLint passed. No database, SQL, browser, live provider, deployment, merge or Ready label. Actual PostgreSQL isolation/encrypted-storage and replay conditions still require their own disposable-DB evidence.


Q coverage audit: two previously missing explicit cases were setup ordinary/support access (#239: 12 setup units passed including the new policy/UI cases) and Company B reading A's new-provider status/balance (#240: 9 accounting units passed). Remaining conditions already have tests: chase-approve/chase-approval-ui on #233 passed 48; tolra-ai, ai-mode-key-isolation, tolra-ai-caps, tolra-ai-caps-ui and tolra-ai-controls-ui on #234 passed 43. N's 5,138-test run includes legacy email round-trips, read-only editor behaviour and paid-break/timesheet comparisons. The actual near-limit race is covered by tests/db/tolra-ai-cap-concurrency.test.ts (two independently blocked connections), but was NOT RUN. The existing setup DB test covers cross-company admins; the new role/support contract tests do not claim live PostgreSQL policy execution. No remaining listed condition is wholly without a test; runtime DB/browser/provider proof remains open.
